To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
smart cities are cities where people can live, work, play, learn and interact within a safe and sustainable environment.

a smart city strategy needs to be based on the local governments vision, needs to have the support of the stakeholders involved, needs to have a focus on the needs of the citizens, needs to have clear goals, needs to have measurable outcomes, needs to be based upon a clear business case.

the CSFs of a smart city strategy are: 1) A clear vision, 2) A good understanding of the city and its stakeholders, 3) An open mindset, 4) A clear and realistic plan, 5) A good governance structure and 6) The right partners.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the six CSFs are: a smart city strategy should be (1) citizen-centric and (2) business-centric; (3) be focused on the long term; (4) be focused on a few key areas; (5) be based on a solid business case; and (6) be based on an integrated approach.

the success of a smart city strategy depends on the following factors: (1) the city’s strategy, (2) the city’s vision, (3) the city’s governance, (4) the city’s citizens, (5) the city’s businesses and (6) the city’s technology.

a smart city strategy should be developed in close cooperation with stakeholders, be focused on a clear goal, be supported with a clear vision, be aligned with the local governments strategy, be supported with clear objectives and be supported with a plan of action.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a smart city strategy should be based on a clear vision, be focused, have clear goals and a clear implementation plan, be supported by the local government, be based on the city’s needs and have a clear communication strategy.
a successful smart city strategy requires a vision, the right partners and the right technology.
smart city strategies need to be tailored to each unique city, but that there are some common factors that should be taken into account when designing such strategies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a smart city strategy needs to be developed by taking into consideration the city’s unique characteristics and goals.
a smart city strategy needs to have a clear vision and goals and be based on a strong foundation.
a smart city strategy is a process that should not be seen as a one-time event.
